bio_en: Dharmapāla was a sixth-century Indian Yogācāra scholar whose interpretations became central to the tradition transmitted by Xuanzang. The Treatise Establishing Consciousness Only gives particular weight to his explanations among the Indian commentarial positions it assembles. Chinese translations also preserve his commentaries on works associated with Āryadeva, Vasubandhu and Dignāga.
bio_summary: 護法為印度瑜伽行派論師，闡唯識義，後世以其說為玄奘所譯《成唯識論》之主要所宗。又有《成唯識寶生論》《觀所緣論釋》等漢譯傳世。
name: 護法
